name: AgentRouter
short: Chinese-language multi-model gateway reselling GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol through one API key at ~27% of official list price. Free credits via daily $25 check-in + $50/invite (no card top-up). GPT-6 Astra limited daily 10:00 Beijing time. Joining requires a GitHub account 6+ months old.

plans.name: Free check-in credits
plans.notes: No card top-up supported. Earn free credits: daily $25 check-in, $50 per invite, email bonus draws, official promos. Balance never expires; no minimum spend. (api/faq, agentrouter.org)

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol all listed at $0 per 1M tokens (free tier) per agentrouter.org/api/pricing. Balance never expires; no minimum spend.

plans.name: Enterprise seats
plans.notes: Monthly seat quotas without weekly limits, SSO/RBAC, usage audit; contact sales. Enterprise trial-quota pilots offered via sales (homepage "大额快速试用").
